site.math.description: Ukusuka kwinqanaba lokuqala ukuya kwelinqabileyo, ziqonde iingcinga zemathematika ezisebenzayo nokusombulula iingxaki zehlabathi lokwenyani ngemisebenzi emnandi.
site.english.description: Ngaphaya kokulungiselela uvavanyo—funda isiNgesi esisebenzayo kuncoko yemihla ngemihla, ukukhula komsebenzi, ishishini, nohambo lwehlabathi ngemisebenzi emifutshane.
site.korean.description: Ukusuka kukubhala kweHangul ukuya kwisiKorea seshishini, vula amathuba noqhagamshelwano olutsha ngezifundo ezichazwe ngolwimi lwakho lwenkobe.
landing.how1.title: Imisebenzi emifutshane
landing.how1.body: Imizuzu emi-3-10 ngexesha. Ingcamango → umzekelo → imibuzo → umngeni, ukuze wakhe uloyiso oluncinci.
landing.how2.title: Zisombulule ngeengcebiso
landing.how2.body: Kulungile ukwenza impazamo. Ingcebiso encinci, ingcebiso eneenkcukacha, emva koko amanyathelo akunceda de uqonde.
landing.how3.title: Zibone ukhula
landing.how3.body: I-XP, amanqanaba, uthotho lweentsuku nemaphu yakho yezakhono zibonisa ukuba ukhule kangakanani namhlanje.
landing.privacy: Asikubuzi igama lakho lokwenyani, inombolo yefowuni okanye isikolo. Igama lomsebenzi nebanga lakho kwanele.
onboarding.nickname.title: Sikubize njani?
onboarding.nickname.hint: Ungasebenzisi igama lakho lokwenyani. Igama lomsebenzi leempawu ezi-2-16 lilungile.

korean.official.note: Ileyibhile eyenziwe yi-AI ngokuthelekisa ikhosi neKharityhulam Esemgangathweni Yolwimi lwesiKorea esemthethweni (amanqanaba 1-6). Ayiyonto yophononongo lwthitshala okanye lwesithethi sobuzalwana kwaye ayilo nqanaba le-TOPIK.
korean.official.pick: Khetha apho uqala khona ngenqanaba elisemthethweni
korean.official.pick.hint: Khetha inqanaba lakho langoku kumanqanaba asemthethweni 1-6 size sicebise ikhosi yokuqala. Usenako ukutshintsha ikhosi ngezantsi.
korean.official.none6: Akukabikho khosi ekhethekileyo yenqanaba elisemthethweni 6. Sicebisa ikhosi ephezulu.
modes.title: Khetha imowudi yokuphonononga
modes.intro: Phonononga into enye ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo. Imibuzo yamanqanaba osele uwafikile kuphela eyavelayo.
modes.listening.desc: Mamela isivakalisi ukhethe esinye kwizinto ezikhoyo.
modes.order.desc: Cwangcisa iziqwenga zamagama ngocwangco olululo. Olunye ucwangco lwamagama lwendalo lunokuba lulungile.
modes.dictation.desc: Bhala isivakalisi osivayo ngokuchanekileyo. Ukupela kufuneka kuchane; kwisiNgesi, oonobumba abakhulu kunye nezithuba okanye izimpawu ezongeziweyo ziyaxolelwa. Izithuba zamagama esiKorea aziyaxolelwa.
modes.noSound: Ukuba awuvi sandi, phonononga nge-“Khetha kwizinto ezikhoyo” okanye “Beka ngocwangco”. Useto lwesandi noncedo zikwiprofayile yakho.
modes.cards.desc: Jonga ngaphambili legama, khumbula intsingiselo yalo, uze uhlole ngasemva. Oku akuchaphazeli i-XP, inqanaba okanye ishedyuli yakho yokuphonononga.
cards.local: Iimpawu “Bendisazi / Kwakhona” zigcinwa kwesi sixhobo kuphela kwaye azitshintshi i-XP okanye ishedyuli yakho yokuphonononga.
tts.title: Useto lwezwi nesandi
tts.voice.none: Akukho zwi le-{lang} elifakiweyo kwesi sixhobo.
tts.disclaimer: Izwi lesixhobo lifunda isicatshulwa kuphela ngokuvakalayo. Alihloli ukubiza kwakho.
tts.help.title: Akukho sandi, okanye akukho zwi le-{lang}?
tts.help.check.volume: Nyusa ivolumu yemidiya kwaye, kwi-iPhone, cima imowudi enethe cwaka.
tts.help.check.mute: Qinisekisa ukuba itab yesihloli-ntanethi ayicinyiwe nokuba isandi asiyi kwisipikha seBluetooth ongasisebenzisiyo.
tts.help.check.browser: Izihloli-ntanethi ezingaphakathi kwezinye izicelo zinokungathethi. Vula eli phepha kwisihloli-ntanethi esiqhelekileyo sefowuni (Safari, Chrome, Edge).
tts.help.ios: iPhone / iPad: Useto → Ukufikeleleka → Umxholo Othethwayo → Amazwi, khetha i-{lang} uze ukhuphele izwi.
tts.help.android: Android: Useto → Ulwimi nokufaka → (okanye Ulawulo Ngokubanzi) → Isicatshulwa-kwintetho → idatha yezwi, uze ufake i-{lang}.
tts.help.windows: Windows: Useto → Ixesha nolwimi → Intetho (okanye Ulwimi nommandla) uze wongeze ipakethe yolwimi nezwi le-{lang}.
tts.help.mac: Mac: Useto Lwenkqubo → Ukufikeleleka → Umxholo Othethwayo → Izwi Lenkqubo → Lawula Amazwi, uze wongeze izwi le-{lang}.
tts.help.restart: Emva kokufaka, vala isihloli-ntanethi ngokupheleleyo uze usivule kwakhona: izwi liya kuvela kuluhlu.
tts.help.menus: Amagama emenyu ayahluka kancinci phakathi kwezixhobo neenguqulelo.
tts.help.alt: Usenako ukuziqhelanisa ngaphandle kwezwi: sombulula usuka kwisicatshulwa nakwi-romanization, okanye uqale ngemibuzo engadingi sandi.
diag.intro.title: Ukuhlolwa kwezakhono kwemizuzu emi-2
diag.intro.body: Oku akuvavanyo olunemarko. Phendula imibuzo embalwa kuphela size sifumane apho unjalo sivule indlela ekufanelekileyo. Ukuba awuyazi enye, yitsibe.
diag.growth: Kulungile, siyigcine njengendawo yakho elandelayo yokukhula.
diag.result.title: Imaphu yam yezakhono
diag.result.body: Le yindawo egqibeleleyo yokuqala. Imisebenzi iya kugcwalisa iindawo zakho zokukhula!

dash.coverage: Yimibuzo engama-{served} kuphela kwengama-{total} efumanekayo kolu lwimi ngoku. Eseleyo iya kuvulwa xa ukuguqulelwa kwayo kulungile.
dash.skills.empty: Gqiba iifundo ukuzalisa imaphu yakho yezakhono.
dash.recent.empty: Sombulula umbuzo wakho wokuqala ufumane ibheji yakho yokuqala!
dash.diagnostic.cta: Fumana indlela yakho ngokuhlolwa kwezakhono kwemizuzu emi-2
dash.guest: Okwangoku inkqubela yakho igcinwa kwesi sixhobo kuphela. Bhalisa ukuqhubeka naphi na.

profile.reset.confirm: Yonke idatha yakho yovavanyo iza kucinywa. Uyayicima?
profile.privacy: Esikugcinayo: igama lomsebenzi, ibanga, injongo, uphawu nenkqubela yokufunda. Asiqokeleli igama lakho lokwenyani, isikolo okanye inombolo yefowuni.
profile.deleteAccount.desc: Cima ngokusisigxina i-akhawunti yakho nayo yonke idatha yokufunda (inkqubela, iincwadi zeempazamo, impumelelo). Ngokuhambelana ne-Apple Guideline 5.1.1(v), esi senzo asinakuphinduswa.
profile.deleteAccount.confirm: Uqinisekile ukuba ufuna ukucima i-akhawunti yakho nayo yonke idatha yokufunda ngokusisigxina? Zonke iirekhodi ziya kucinywa ngoko nangoko kwaye azinakubuyiselwa.
profile.deleteAccount.done: I-akhawunti nayo yonke idatha zicinywe ngokusisigxina.

onboarding.korean.account_limit: Amanqanaba K7–K10 aphononongwa kwaye akafumaneki okwangoku. Nceda ukhethe inqanaba ukusuka kwi-K1 ukuya kwi-K6.
pron.heading: Ingcebiso yokubiza
pron.final: Ekupheleni kwegama okanye phambi kwesikhamandi, isikhamandi sokugqibela esiyi-stop eqinileyo okanye enomoya, s, j okanye ch (iintlobo ze-k-, t-, p- neesibilants) sibizwa njenge-k, t okanye p eqhelekileyo, umzekelo {ex}.
pron.liaison: Xa isikhamandi sokugqibela esinye okanye esiphindwe kabini silandelwa sisinxulumani, isiphelo okanye isimaphambili esiqala ngevawuli (esibhalwe ngesikhamandi sokuqala esithe cwaka), isikhamandi sokugqibela sibizwa njengokuqala kwesilebhile elandelayo, umzekelo {ex}.
pron.nasal: Isandi sokugqibela se-stop (uhlobo lwe-k, t okanye p) siba sisandi sempumlo (ng, n okanye m) phambi kwesikhamandi sempumlo (n okanye m), umzekelo {ex}.
pron.lateral: Xa isandi se-n nesandi se-l/r zidibana kumda wesilebhile, zihlala zibizwa njenge-l (kukho ezimbalwa ezingaphandle), umzekelo {ex}.
pron.tense: Emva kwesandi sokugqibela se-stop (uhlobo lwe-k, t okanye p), isikhamandi esiqhelekileyo esilandelayo (uhlobo lwe-g, d, b, s okanye j) sibizwa siqinile, umzekelo {ex}.
pron.source: Umthombo: Imigaqo Yokubiza Esemgangathweni Yesikorea, inqaku {art} (National Institute of Korean Language).
pron.note: Le ngcebiso ichaza umgaqo. Izwi lesixhobo sakho lidlala isandi kuphela; le app ayigwebi ukubiza kwakho.
korean.band.title: Inkqubela ngenqanaba
korean.band.pick.hint: Khetha inqanaba elisondele kakhulu kwelakho (Intshayelelo okanye amanqanaba 1–5) size sikuqalise kwikhosi efanelekileyo. Ukuhlolwa kokubekwa emva koko kunganqumla oko seleukwazi.
korean.band.preparing: Inqanaba 6 liyalungiswa kwaye livulwa xa umxholo walo ulungile.
korean.band.note: Ezi leyibhile zibonisa iinjongo zokufunda. Aziyonto yesatifikethi okanye inqanaba le-TOPIK, kwaye iziphumo zokufunda okanye zokukhetha ezininzi azilinganisi bunekrelelo jikelele bolwimi lwesiKorea okanye ukuthetha.
think.hub.title: Imiceli mngeni yokucinga
think.hub.intro: Ayiyo imibuzo enempendulo enye echanekileyo: imisebenzi apho uthelekisa ubungqina, uthelekisa, ulungisa iimpazamo wenze imizekelo yakho. Yahlukile kwiifundo eziqhelekileyo - yizame nanini na ufuna.
think.hub.notTranslated: Imisebenzi engekaguqulelwa kulwimi lwakho ifihliwe kwaye iya kuvulwa xa ukuguqulelwa kulungile. Imisebenzi efihliweyo
think.hub.koFirst.note: Ukusuka kwinqanaba 4 imiyalelo ikwisiKorea. Ungabonisa ulwimi lwakho ecaleni kwayo.
profile.import.bad: Le ayiyo ifayile yenkqubela yale sayithi.
profile.backup.hint: Inkqubela yovavanyo igcinwa kwisihloli-ntanethi sesi sixhobo kuphela. Yigcine kwifayile ngaphambi kokutshintsha izixhobo okanye ukucima idatha yesihloli-ntanethi.
